summary: Backend API tests completed successfully for WhatsFlow. All 24 pytest test cases passed (100% success rate) covering root, dashboard (stats/activity), customers full CRUD + filter, templates CRUD + duplicate 409, WhatsApp status/qr/incoming webhook, settings GET/PUT with persistence, trials/payments list, messages conversations, message persistence after incoming webhook, and payments customer info endpoint. External integrations (painel.fun, 2Captcha, InfinitePay) were intentionally NOT triggered per instructions.

minor.issue: Returns 200 instead of 201 for creation (minor REST convention)
Returns 200 instead of 201 for creation (minor REST convention)

critical_code_review_comments: settings.py: sensitive values (painel_password, twocaptcha_key) are returned in plaintext alongside a *_masked version — the raw values should probably NOT be returned by GET /api/settings; only the masked version should be exposed.

payments.py get_customer_payment_info: prices_cents dict uses int keys (1,3,6,12) — JSON serialisation converts them to string keys, which may confuse frontend clients expecting integers. Consider documenting or normalising.

server.py: WhatsApp Node service is spawned via subprocess.Popen in the FastAPI lifespan; if the container has multiple uvicorn workers this could spawn multiple Node processes. Fine for single-worker deploy but worth noting.
trials.py: raw_response column referenced but Trial pydantic model filter uses set-difference logic that assumes it always exists; brittle if schema changes.
whatsapp router IncomingPayload duplicates fields already defined in models.IncomingWhatsAppMessage — consider consolidating.
test_credentials: n/a — no auth in this backend
seed_data_creation: Test data prefixed with TEST_ was created and cleaned up in the same run (customers, templates, an incoming whatsapp message for 5511999999999 remains persisted in messages table).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Frontend not tested. External integrations (painel.fun trial creation, 2Captcha, InfinitePay link creation) were skipped intentionally per instructions — needs live/manual testing with real credentials. WhatsApp Node service state was accepted as 'awaiting_qr'.
